name: MARS-Bench
intro: MARS-Bench 是从真实 NBA/NHL 逐事件比赛记录构建的多轮体育真实场景对话基准，用于评估超多轮、交互式多轮和跨轮对话能力。它包含 120 场比赛、4,010 次查询，平均每场 33.42 个对话轮次，覆盖指令遵循、上下文检索、信息推理和任务切换四类任务，并提供英文与中文数据。
org: ByteDance Seed, University of Science and Technology of China
build_method: ESPN/虎扑体育实况采集, 结构化处理, 人工问题设计, 正则答案抽取, 检查清单构建, 三阶段质量控制
metric: 基于检查清单的 LLM 裁判准确率（%）
task_type: 指令遵循, 上下文检索, 信息推理, 任务切换
eval_feature: 超多轮, 交互式多轮, 跨轮任务, 任务切换, 双语
scale: 120场比赛；平均每场33.42轮；4,010次查询；每类任务30场（英文NBA 15场、中文NBA 10场、英文NHL 5场）
task_type_en: Instruction Following, Context Retrieval, Information Reasoning, Task Switching
build_method_en: ESPN/Hupu Sports Data Collection, Structured Processing, Manual Question Design, Regex-based Answer Extraction, Checklist Construction, Three-stage Quality Assurance
eval_feature_en: Ultra Multi-turn, Interactive Multi-turn, Cross-turn Tasks, Task Switching, Bilingual
intro_en: MARS-Bench is a multi-turn athletic real-world scenario dialogue benchmark built from real NBA and NHL play-by-play records. It evaluates ultra multi-turn, interactive multi-turn, and cross-turn dialogue capabilities through four task categories—Instruction Following, Context Retrieval, Information Reasoning, and Task Switching—and contains 120 games, 4,010 queries, and an average of 33.42 dialogue turns per game in English and Chinese.
scale_en: 120 games; 33.42 dialogue turns per game on average; 4,010 queries; 30 games per task category (15 English NBA, 10 Chinese NBA, 5 English NHL)
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Collect ESPN English NBA/NHL and Hupu Chinese NBA sports records"] --> B["Standardize each complete game into play-by-play, rosters, and post-game statistics"]
    B --> C["Use play-by-play and rosters as model input"]
    B --> D["Reserve post-game statistics for answer verification"]
    C --> E["Define Instruction Following, Context Retrieval, Information Reasoning, and Task Switching"]
    E --> F["Manually design questions by period and task type"]
    F --> G["Use regular expressions to select context and derive unique reference answers"]
    G --> H["Create weighted evidence checklists with first-check overrides"]
    D --> I["Check five questions per question type to verify automatic answer extraction"]
    H --> I
    I --> J["Perform independent author cross-review"]
    J --> K["Use DeepSeek-V3-0324 to assist consistency inspection"]
    K --> L["Insert category questions into five score-tracking turns per period"]
    L --> M["Finalize 120 games and 4,010 queries averaging 33.42 turns"]
    M --> N["Run zero-shot models incrementally at every turn"]
    N --> O["Use the reference answer as context and score solely against the weighted checklist"]
    O --> P["Report task-level and overall accuracy"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["收集 ESPN 英文 NBA/NHL 与虎扑中文 NBA 体育记录"] --> B["把每场完整比赛标准化为逐事件实况、阵容和赛后统计"]
    B --> C["把逐事件实况和阵容作为模型输入"]
    B --> D["仅用赛后统计核验答案"]
    C --> E["定义指令遵循、上下文检索、信息推理和任务切换四类任务"]
    E --> F["按比赛节次与任务类型人工设计问题"]
    F --> G["用正则筛选上下文并派生唯一参考答案"]
    G --> H["构建带首检归零条件的加权证据清单"]
    D --> I["每种题型抽检五题，核验自动答案抽取"]
    H --> I
    I --> J["执行作者独立交叉复核"]
    J --> K["用 DeepSeek-V3-0324 辅助一致性检查"]
    K --> L["每节拆为五个比分轮次并插入分类问题"]
    L --> M["最终形成 120 场比赛、4,010 次查询，平均 33.42 轮"]
    M --> N["目标模型零样本逐轮作答"]
    N --> O["参考答案只作上下文，裁判仅依据加权检查清单评分"]
    O --> P["报告分任务与总体准确率"]
drawio_review_note: Rebuilt against ACL Findings EMNLP 2025 Figures 1 and 3, Sections 3.1-3.3 and 4.1, Appendix F, and the official Syuchin/MARS-Bench repository and evaluator. The bilingual diagrams preserve ESPN English NBA/NHL plus Hupu Chinese NBA collection; separate model-input play-by-play/rosters from verification-only post-game statistics; show four task categories, regex-derived unique answers, weighted checklists, three-stage quality assurance, dialogue assembly before the final 120-game/4,010-query/33.42-turn dataset, incremental zero-shot evaluation, and checklist-only judging with the reference answer used as context.
